cases.name: Verify that the currently saved shop topic is a brand new preset and does not overwrite the previous preset
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront / Style

steps.desc: 1. Curator Go to my shop and click Customize shop, then click Style
steps.result: 1. Successfully enter the "Style" page

steps.desc: 2. Click "..." - "Apply style settings", set the template as "Midnight Glow", set the font as" Dosis ", set the Storefront background color as "# 972C2C ", the Post card border color as "#C0B49E", the Product card background color as "# B8A797 ", and then click "..." - "Save current style", enter the character "test1" in the name field, and finally click the "Save" button
steps.result: 2. The theme preset was successfully saved. The template is "Midnight Glow ", the font is" Dosis ", the Storefront background color as "# 972C2C ", the Post card border color as "#C0B49E", the Product card background color as "# B8A797".

steps.desc: 3. Set the template to "Shadow focus", the page background color to "#E8F3FC", the font to "Josefin Sans", and then click "..." - "Save current style" save it as a preset named "test2".
steps.result: 3. Successfully save the theme preset "test2", set the page background color to "#E8F3FC", and set the font to "Josefin Sans"

steps.desc: 4. Click "Manage saved styles"
steps.result: 4. There are two theme presets, test1 and test2

cases.name: Verify the status when creating or editing the shop topic name as an extremely long character, an empty name, and a duplicate name
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront / Style
cases.condition: There is already a preset named "test1".

steps.desc: 1. Curator Go to my shop and click Customize shop, then click Style
steps.result: 1. Successfully enter the Style page

steps.desc: 2. Click "..." - "Apply style settings", set the template as "Midnight Glow", set the font as" Dosis ", set the Storefront background color as "# 972C2C ", the Post card border color as "#C0B49E", the Product card background color as "# B8A797 ", and then click "..." - "Save current style", enter the character "testtesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttest" in the name field, and finally click the "Save" button
steps.result: 2. Successfully saved, but because the name is too long, only one column will be displayed, and the extra name will be shown as "..."

steps.desc: 3. Enter the duplicate value "test1" in the name field, and finally click the "Save" button
steps.result: 3. Failed to save successfully because The value was duplicated and prompted "The name already exists, please try another name."

steps.desc: 4. The name field is an empty value. Finally, click the "Save" button
steps.result: 4. It cannot be saved because the value cannot be empty
